operational_residual_rule.depth_mae_exceeds: max(0.5 m, 0.05 * median reference depth, 3 * reference plane RMS)
operational_residual_rule.note: one metric suffices for candidate; this is a cost-control discovery definition, not paper significance or human acceptance

scale_protocol: pure RGB forward with public camera-baseline metric conversion separated from visual + outside-target INPUT LiDAR global scale; no heldout fitting; same calibration algorithm and target exclusion across comparisons; local INPUT plane separate extra-information reference

new_sources.selection: first 8 sorted locally available metadata log directories excluding sealed 10-log reserve; fixed before RGB and model-quality access
new_sources.selection_timestamp: middle available LiDAR timestamp; nearest RGB, context +/-0.5 seconds

intervention: same target camera; target alone vs target plus two actually visible temporal observations at +/-0.5s; require calibrated visible support and parallax >=1deg, fixed target and input metric calibration protocol; recovery restores exactly removed observations; no synthetic stress escalation
conditional_downstream: DGGT core/Gaussian/RGB pilot may establish executable method contract; scientific failure extension and independent confirmation only for surviving first three links
stop: stop after this single frozen batch; if ordinary controls remove meaningful residuals or valid evidence removal shows no repeatable degradation, lower or close joint sparse-view x low-texture claim; absent data or executable contract is a missing-evidence result, not model robustness
